title: Lisse integral structures exist etale locally
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite with valuation ring $A=\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme], on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] write $A_X(V)=C(|V|,A)$ and $E_X(V)=C(|V|,E)$, with pointwise ring operations and restriction by precomposition. Here pro-etale locally free of finite rank means that there is a covering of the final object in the pro-etale site on each member of which the module is isomorphic to a finite direct sum of copies of its coefficient ring sheaf; ranks may vary between members, and rank zero is allowed. Inverse images are those of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Modules and tensor products are sheaf modules and sheaf tensor products [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. If $L$ is an $E_X$-module sheaf pro-etale locally free of finite rank, there is an etale covering family $(u_i:Y_i\to X)_i$ [def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and, for each $i$, an $A_{Y_i}$-module sheaf $M_i$ pro-etale locally free of finite rank with an isomorphism $E_{Y_i}\otimes_{A_{Y_i}}M_i\cong u_i^{-1}L$. In this formula the inverse image has its $E_{Y_i}$-action by the slice-site coefficient identification.
